Constraints: one equipment layer only; clean alpha edges; full canonical canvas; no labels, no text, no watermark; no full Pegasus; no new figure; no saddle; no headpiece; no hoof jewelry; no floating ornaments.

provenance: Original body-specific built-in image_gen front layer generated from the exact Pegasus body, existing rear layer, and previous browser composition.
